[Diagram: axes labeled 'exchange rate' (vertical) and 'quantity' (horizontal); downward-sloping demand curve D; two upward-sloping supply curves S₁ and S₂, with S₂ to the right of S₁; intersection of D and S₁ at (Q₁, P₁); intersection of D and S₂ at (Q₂, P₂), where Q₂ > Q₁ and P₂ < P₁]

What is likely to have caused this change in the value of the Euro?

A a decrease in European Union inflation
B a decrease in US interest rates
C an increase in European Union imports
D an increase in European Union unemployment
options: A a decrease in European Union inflation
B a decrease in US interest rates
C an increase in European Union imports
D an increase in European Union unemployment
